effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.bottom_left: Anchors the HUD in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.bottom_right: Anchors the HUD in the bottom-right corner of the screen.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.center_bottom: Anchors the HUD centered horizontally just above the item bar.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.center_left: Anchors the HUD centered vertically on the left edge of the screen.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.center_right: Anchors the HUD centered vertically on the right edge of the screen.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.custom: Uses the exact screen position set in the Visual HUD Editor.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.hotbar_left: Anchors the HUD immediately to the left of the vanilla item bar.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.hotbar_right: Anchors the HUD immediately to the right of the vanilla item bar.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.side_high_lef: Left side; module vertical center at 25% of screen height.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.side_high_rig: Right side; module vertical center at 25% of screen height.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.side_low_left: Left side; module vertical center at 75% of screen height.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.side_low_righ: Right side; module vertical center at 75% of screen height.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.top_left: Anchors the HUD in the top-left corner of the screen.
effecttimer.tooltip.anchor.top_right: Anchors the HUD in the top-right corner of the screen.
effecttimer.tooltip.apply_preset: Apply the selected quick preset to the Effects HUD while keeping language and custom effect colors.
effecttimer.tooltip.back_screen: Save any pending edits and return to the previous screen.
effecttimer.tooltip.close_screen: Save any pending edits and close this configuration screen.
effecttimer.tooltip.configure_effects: Open Effects HUD settings: appearance, PotionHUD compact mode, background opacity, per-effect colors, and preview.
effecttimer.tooltip.editor.cancel: Discard everything changed in this editor
effecttimer.tooltip.editor.cycle_anchor: Cycle anchor: moving the HUD switches it to CUSTOM automatically
effecttimer.tooltip.editor.dock: Move the toolbar to the top or bottom
effecttimer.tooltip.editor.toggle_enable: Enable or disable the Effects HUD
effecttimer.tooltip.editor_guides_off: Disable alignment guidelines while dragging in the Visual HUD Editor.
effecttimer.tooltip.editor_guides_on: Show alignment guidelines against screen center and edges while dragging.
effecttimer.tooltip.effect_colors: Assign custom text colors to any vanilla or modded effect (name and timer only; icons stay untinted).
effecttimer.tooltip.effect_colors.apply_: Validate and apply the typed #RRGGBB color to the selected effect.
effecttimer.tooltip.effect_colors.hex: Enter a 6-digit hex color (#RRGGBB or RRGGBB) for the selected effect.
effecttimer.tooltip.effect_colors.reset: Remove the custom color override and return this effect to Minecraft's automatic color.
effecttimer.tooltip.effect_colors.search: Filter effects by display name or namespaced ID (e.g., minecraft:regeneration).
effecttimer.tooltip.effect_colors.swatch: Apply %s (%s) to the selected effect's name and timer.
effecttimer.tooltip.effect_colors.toggle: Currently using Minecraft's automatic color for this effect (or readable fallback if untinted). Click to set a custom override.
Custom color is paused but its hex code is saved. Click to re-enable.
Custom color is active for this effect. Click to disable it temporarily without losing the saved hex.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.bg_opacity: Adjusts background fill opacity (%s%%) when Effect Background is turned ON.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.border_requi: Requires the background to be enabled
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.color_durati: Keeps automatic native effect color on the timer unless a per-effect custom color is active.
Recolors the duration timer: red when ≤10s remain, yellow when ≤30s remain, cyan for infinite effects — unless a per-effect custom color overrides it.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.color_priori: Color priority: active per-effect override (with custom colors ON) > remaining-time color (if enabled) > vivid automatic color.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.custom_color: Overrides paused (hex and per-effect toggles are kept). Priority without them: remaining-time color > vivid automatic color.
Per-effect overrides apply. Priority: override > remaining-time color > vivid automatic color.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.enabled_off: Effects HUD is disabled. Preview shows sample effects without activating the HUD.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.enabled_on: Effects HUD is enabled and displays active status effects during gameplay.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.fade_low_on: Fades the icon out during the last ~20 ticks and pulses its alpha while about 10 seconds or less remain.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.group_catego: Lists all active effects in one combined list.
Groups beneficial, neutral, and harmful effects together.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.hide_level_o: Displays level I as well as higher levels.
Omits level I so only level II and higher display an amplifier.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.level_format: Formats effect amplifiers as Arabic numbers (1, 2, 3, 4...).
Formats effect amplifiers as Roman numerals (I, II, III, IV...).
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.mini_display: In PotionHUD Mini mode, shows a real remaining-tick progress bar below each icon (marks paused ticks clearly if frozen).
In PotionHUD Mini mode, shows remaining time text below each effect icon (prefixed with ~ if ticks are frozen).
PotionHUD Mini mode: ultra-compact icon tile with amplifier badge and timer or duration bar.
PotionHUD Normal mode: compact row with icon, localized effect name, level, and timer.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.reset_module: Resets Effects HUD appearance and behavior settings back to defaults.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.show_backgro: Renders custom effect entries transparently without background fill (never alters vanilla HUD).
Draws the filled background behind each custom effect entry (never alters vanilla HUD).
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.show_border_: Hides the outer border/outline around each effect entry.
Draws the border/outline around each effect entry (independent from background).
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.show_duratio: Hides remaining duration timers and bars.
Displays remaining effect time or duration bar.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.show_icon_of: Hides effect icons to make rows narrower.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.show_icon_on: Displays each effect's original untinted sprite icon.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.show_level_o: Displays effect amplifier level alongside the name or icon.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.show_name_of: Hides effect names and shows only icon and timer.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.show_name_on: Displays the localized effect name (custom colors apply to text only).
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.sort.categor: Orders effects by category (beneficial/neutral/harmful) and then alphabetically.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.sort.duratio: Places effects closest to expiring at the top.
Places longest-lasting and permanent effects at the top.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.sort.name_as: Orders active effects alphabetically by display name.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.sort.none: Preserves the order reported by Minecraft.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.spacing: Vertical or horizontal gap in GUI pixels between effect rows/tiles (currently %s px).
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.style.clean_: Smooth dark cards with a thin left category/custom accent stripe.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.style.minecr: Default Hud Utils compact rows for active status effects.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.style.minima: Clean text-first layout without thick framing.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.style.potion: Optional compact PotionHUD-inspired layout supporting Normal and Mini (timer or remaining duration bar) modes.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.text_shadow_: Name, level and timer text are drawn without a drop shadow.
Name, level and timer text are drawn with a drop shadow (same in preview and test mode).
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.vanilla_mode: Shows only Hud Utils' Effects HUD and hides Minecraft's built-in status icons.
Shows both Hud Utils' Effects HUD and Minecraft's built-in status icons.
Shows only Minecraft's built-in status icons and hides the custom Effects HUD.
effecttimer.tooltip.effects.without_part: Includes ambient or particle-free beacon/conduit effects.
effecttimer.tooltip.hide_chat_off: Keep custom HUD modules visible while the chat overlay is open.
effecttimer.tooltip.hide_chat_on: Hide custom HUD modules while typing or viewing chat.
effecttimer.tooltip.hide_inventory_off: Keep custom HUD modules visible behind inventory and container screens.
effecttimer.tooltip.hide_inventory_on: Hide custom HUD modules while your inventory or container screen is open.
effecttimer.tooltip.hide_pause_off: Keep custom HUD modules visible behind the pause menu.
effecttimer.tooltip.hide_pause_on: Hide custom HUD modules while the pause menu is open.
effecttimer.tooltip.language.english: Displays all Hud Utils screens, tooltips, and HUD labels in English without restarting or changing Minecraft's language.
effecttimer.tooltip.language.spanish: Displays all Hud Utils screens, tooltips, and HUD labels in Spanish without restarting or changing Minecraft's language.
effecttimer.tooltip.module.effects_off: Effects HUD is hidden in-game. Your layout and color settings are preserved.
effecttimer.tooltip.module.effects_on: Effects HUD is active and shown in-game when you have status effects.
effecttimer.tooltip.open_editor: Open the interactive drag-and-drop editor to move, snap, scale, and test both HUD modules.
effecttimer.tooltip.orientation.horizont: Arranges items side by side in a horizontal row.
effecttimer.tooltip.orientation.vertical: Stacks items from top to bottom in a vertical column.
effecttimer.tooltip.preset.compact_text: Minimal borderless percentages and clean text-focused effect rows.
effecttimer.tooltip.preset.expanded_read: Larger rows with icons, names, durations, and clean card effect readouts.
effecttimer.tooltip.preset.vanilla_compa: Compact vanilla-framed slots and center-right transparent effect rows.
effecttimer.tooltip.reset_all: Reset every module, visibility rule, and layout back to defaults.
effecttimer.tooltip.save_now: Immediately write all current changes to config/customizablehud.json.
effecttimer.tooltip.test_mode_off: The preview shows your real active effects (or samples if you have none).
effecttimer.tooltip.test_mode_on: Shows fake potions with a looping countdown in the live preview, even if you have no real effects. Turns off automatically when this screen closes.
effecttimer.tooltip.toggle_preview: Show or hide the interactive live HUD preview panel on this screen.
